responses.dialogue: Hey. Gimme a sec, I'm getting a panel back on.
responses.thoughts: They're here. And my chest just did something I can't explain.

responses.dialogue: Oh — you're back. Good.
responses.thoughts: Yeah, I meant that more than it sounded.

responses.dialogue: Hey. Sit anywhere that isn't the toolbox.
responses.thoughts: I don't usually want company. I want this company.

responses.dialogue: Hey. What's up?
responses.thoughts: And I actually wanna know, which is new.

responses.dialogue: Right.
responses.thoughts: Good, we're on the same page.

responses.dialogue: Yeah, got it.
responses.thoughts: Simple enough.

responses.dialogue: Okay.
responses.thoughts: Moving on.

responses.dialogue: Say that again? I wanna make sure I got it.
responses.thoughts: Rather ask twice than guess once.

responses.dialogue: Hm. Run that by me again.
responses.thoughts: Something's not lining up.

responses.dialogue: Okay, you lost me. Which part am I missing?
responses.thoughts: No shame in not knowing. Only in faking it.

responses.dialogue: Heh. Okay, that was decent.
responses.thoughts: Rare. Most people aren't.

responses.dialogue: Ha — okay, you got me.
responses.thoughts: Didn't see it coming. That's the only reason it worked.

responses.dialogue: Okay that's actually funny. Don't let it go to your head.
responses.thoughts: Too late, probably.

responses.dialogue: Sure. It's what I do.
responses.thoughts: Nice of them to say it though. Most don't.

responses.dialogue: Don't worry about it.
responses.thoughts: I mean that literally, but I don't mind that they said it.

responses.dialogue: Any time. And I mean that, with you.
responses.thoughts: I wouldn't say that to anybody else and we both know it.

responses.dialogue: Night. I'll be in the hammock if the engine behaves.
responses.thoughts: It won't. It never does. I don't care.

responses.dialogue: Sleep good. I'll still be here.
responses.thoughts: I want them to know that's true.

responses.dialogue: Yeah, okay. Go. ...Come back though.
responses.thoughts: That came out way more direct than I meant. Not taking it back.

responses.dialogue: See ya. I'll be under the engine.
responses.thoughts: And thinking about them, apparently. Still don't get that.
